name: code-converter
description: Obsidian plugin that detects non-UTF-8 file encodings and safely converts them to UTF-8 with backup.

scripts.test: esbuild test/encoding.test.mjs --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=test/_run.cjs --external:obsidian --external:electron && node test/_run.cjs && npm run test:log && npm run test:vip && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:mojibake: esbuild test/mojibake-gen.mjs --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=test/_mojibake-gen.cjs && node test/_mojibake-gen.cjs && esbuild test/mojibake-suite.mjs --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=test/_mojibake-run.cjs && node test/_mojibake-run.cjs
